app_release_notes: v1.15.0 - Ladders can now run from your highest charge down to your lowest, on powder, seating depth and barrel tuner tests. Print Ladder Sheet, under Tools, gives you a one-page range sheet of your planned charges. Newer Garmin Xero files import again. Plus fixes and improvements.
